controls.label: Monochrome
controls.title: Thomas’s registered Galileo mosaic combines detailed images with a coarser background. Its high-pass processing reduces broad brightness differences but retains photographed shading and seams; it is not calibrated albedo. Source sampling varies greatly. Gray grid marks source-defined unprojectable surfaces. Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: Color shows source radius minus a 16 km reference sphere, including Ida’s broad irregular shape. This is radial height, not gravitational elevation. Brightness adds cartographic relief derived from the 2° shape grid; the displayed silhouette is simplified. Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting.
